DuckDB-Wasm 1.32.0
https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb-wasm
MIT license: see LICENSE

The browser module, worker, and WebAssembly binary in this directory are from
the official @duckdb/duckdb-wasm 1.32.0 npm package. The browser module was
bundled with esbuild to include its npm dependencies. Queries run locally in
the visitor's browser. The engine is loaded only when the visitor clicks Run.
The bundle includes Apache Arrow JavaScript (Apache-2.0); see
APACHE-ARROW-LICENSE.txt and APACHE-ARROW-NOTICE.txt.
